posts.text: In SF for Tech Week finally! Here Oct 3–16. Doing the Cansbridge Scholars bootcamp during the day and running around to events after. A few I'm excited for: the Datadog Boba & Build Night, The Talent Hunt, and the Sentry rooftop for the Blue Angels flyover. Also somehow signed up for a 7:30am run club, so we'll see how that goes. I'm a 3rd-year CS student at Western, previously at Wealthsimple and RBC, looking for 2027 SWE internships in SF or NYC. If you're in the city, hit me up. And if we've

Four months ago I didn't know what CORAL was. Now it's a patent-pending solution already deployed at RBC, built on one idea: every click tells a story, and CORAL helps you CORALate it. It started as a problem statement, not a spec. We built from there, going back to the teams who'd actually use CORAL for constant feedback and reshaping the product around what they told us. So grateful to have co-hosted this with Mitra Sarwari and everyone at Rewriting the Code. Seeing the conversations and connections made all the planning worth it. Hoping it’s the first of many. Hit me up if you’re organizing an event and need a co-host :)
